stories.name_fr: BPA de base de milieu de cycle
stories.explanation: Base de bénéfice par action de milieu de cycle mise à jour.
stories.story_fr: Bunge a mis à jour sa base de bénéfice par action de milieu de cycle à environ 13 dollars.
stories.story_en: Bunge updated its mid-cycle EPS baseline to approximately $13.
stories.citation: The Company has updated its EPS mid-cycle baseline to approximately $13

stories.name_en: EPS baseline target by end of 2030
stories.explanation: Hausse attendue de la base de bénéfice par action.
stories.story_fr: Bunge prévoit de porter sa base de bénéfice par action à au moins 15 dollars d’ici la fin 2030, contre environ 13 dollars aujourd’hui.
stories.story_en: Bunge expects its EPS baseline to rise to at least $15 by the end of 2030, from about $13 today.
stories.citation: provides growth for an expected increase to at least $15 by the end of 2030

stories.explanation: Nouveau programme de rachat autorisé par le conseil.
stories.story_fr: Le conseil de Bunge a autorisé un nouveau programme de rachat d’actions pouvant atteindre 3 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: Bunge's Board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $3 billion.
stories.citation: Announces new $3 Billion Share Repurchase Program

stories.name_en: Share of discretionary cash flow returned
stories.explanation: Dividendes et rachats d’actions cumulés sur le cycle.
stories.story_fr: Bunge vise à rendre au moins 50 % de son flux de trésorerie discrétionnaire aux actionnaires, par dividendes et rachats d’actions, sur le cycle.
stories.story_en: Bunge commits to returning at least 50% of discretionary cash flow to shareholders through dividends and buybacks across the cycle.
stories.citation: commitment to returning a minimum of 50% of discretionary cash flow to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases across the cycle

sondes.citation: authorized the repurchase of up to $3 billion of Bunge's common shares
an expected increase to its EPS baseline to at least $15 by the end of 2030
a minimum of 50% of its discretionary cash flow to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases across the cycle
